name: tasc_bicycle
description: Does a bicycle-sized target change what HiDrive does on the 24 TASC cyclist cases? The same cases as tasc_cyclist_*, with object_2 as an assumed 1.8 x 0.6 x 1.7 m bicycle box instead of the 5.0 x 1.8 m car box of the files (import-tasc --bicycle). Groups and levels as in tasc_tolerance, so each case compares with its car-box run. Sensitivity levels, not sensor values. 1080 runs.
